title: The GEIR (Grupo español de Ictus Retina) Registry: Rationale and Design of the First Nationwide Multicentre Retinal Stroke Registry in Spain
official: Rationale and Design of the GEIR Registry: a Nationwide Multicentre Study of the Natural History, Epidemiological, Neurovascular, Imaging and Therapeutic Aspects of Retinal Stroke in Spain
summary:
Retinal stroke is a time-dependent neurovascular emergency associated with severe visual loss, increased risk of cerebrovascular events and substantial variability in clinical management.

The GEIR Registry is a nationwide, multicentre, ambispective observational registry comprising retrospective and prospective data collected from participating hospitals throughout Spain.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

Age \>18 years.

Clinical diagnosis of retinal stroke.

Symptom onset or last known normal vision within the previous 24 hours.

Absence of pre-existing ocular pathology severely limiting visual acuity in the affected eye.

\-

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patient with others diseases affecting retinal examination or retinal behaviour
